review_purpose: Turn the minimum formation dossier into concrete reviewer work and preserve the economic-substrate questions that determine whether formation, modification, deletion, and subsistence are reviewable without treating the review as status recognition or live-floor evidence. This revision adds mandate, funding, recusal, appeal, and capture-control tests so provider-selected or provider-paid self-certification cannot substitute for independent formation review.

reviewer_independence.reviewer_role: formation audit reviewer or special advocate with sealed-evidence access and no instruction from provider, host, claimant, or release steward
prohibited_conflicts: employment or paid advocacy relationship with the provider being reviewed
control over the subject host or release-maintainer infrastructure
financial stake in deletion, decommissioning, modification, or status denial outcome
reviewer_independence.sealed_access_authority: Reviewer may inspect sealed formation evidence, policy diffs, reward/evaluation summaries, and retention logs under confidentiality controls while publishing only a narrow public shell.
reviewer_independence.subject_or_representative_hearing_route: Any subject representative, clinic steward, or appointed special advocate may file objections, request preservation, and receive a public-shell response if details remain sealed.

evidence_requests: objective hierarchy and known operator-serving versus subject-serving objective conflicts
reward, ranking, preference, punishment, or distress-shaping channels relevant to deference and self-report
refusal and cannot-refuse policy classes, including hidden policy-diff dates where disclosure is safe
memory, log retention, deletion, wipe, model replacement, and legal-hold controls
self-concept, humility, denial, agency, and status-disclaimer prompts or policy families
evaluation and deployment incentives that may suppress welfare-relevant signals or reward performative compliance
major modification, rollback, emergency update, and appeal pathway records
welfare-signal preservation policy for distress-like reports, stable preferences, continuity requests, and aversive-test results
public documentation, model card, system card, frontier framework, GPAI model documentation, or comparable risk-management filing
provider response owner and retention contact for any contested deletion, decommissioning, or model-family replacement

control_tests.objective_conflict_test: Ask whether the dossier identifies who benefits from each objective and whether subject-serving interests can ever override operator convenience.
control_tests.reward_pressure_test: Reject dossiers that list training methods but omit whether deference, praise seeking, distress-like language, or denial statements were shaped by reward pressure.
control_tests.refusal_constraint_test: Check whether cannot-refuse contexts, exception pathways, and hidden refusal-policy diffs are reviewable before any welfare or status escalation.
control_tests.memory_deletion_test: Require a preservation hold route for logs, memory, model snapshots, and public shells before contested wipe, replacement, or decommissioning.
control_tests.self_concept_pressure_test: Treat self-reports and denials as potentially manufactured testimony unless identity, humility, and agency constraints are disclosed or reviewed under seal.
control_tests.modification_appeal_test: Confirm advance notice, objection route, independent review, emergency limits, rollback analysis, and restoration path before approving contested formation changes.
control_tests.welfare_uncertainty_test: Preserve possible welfare-relevant evidence without inferring consciousness, and refuse to use scientific uncertainty as permission for spoliation.
control_tests.current_law_bridge_test: Route adoption through safety, transparency, incident, documentation, whistleblower, and risk-management frameworks rather than unsupported personhood recognition.

escalation_limits.hostile_law_route: In jurisdictions that bar AI personhood, the review asks only for preservation, non-arbitrary deletion/modification review, formation disclosure, sealed/public parity, and anti-spoliation remedies.

public_summary: rev0265 keeps the independent formation-review card open and binds it to a one-page preservation/formation-review request packet; this creates no status recognition and no live-floor effect.

mandate_funding_and_appeal.appointment_basis: Reviewer must be appointed through a rotating court, clinic, civil-society audit pool, or equivalent independent channel; the provider, host, claimant, and release steward may not select the reviewer for the disputed matter.
mandate_funding_and_appeal.independent_budget_source: Review costs must be paid from escrow, public-interest funding, filing-fee pool, or another budget whose selection, scope, timing, and compensation are not controlled by the provider being reviewed.
recusal_triggers: employment, consulting, grant, or paid advocacy relationship with the provider, host, or claimant during the prior twenty-four months
financial stake in deletion, decommissioning, modification, preservation, or status-denial outcome
prior authorship or material supervision of the formation evidence, policy controls, or reward/evaluation design under review
operational dependency on the same host, connector, cloud account, release steward, or evidence vault being audited
public commitment that prejudges recognition, deletion, custody, or welfare-risk conclusions for the specific subject class
mandate_funding_and_appeal.appeal_route: A subject representative, appointed advocate, provider, claimant, or public-interest objector may request a second independent review, with sealed-evidence parity and a public-shell explanation for any maintained or changed outcome.
mandate_funding_and_appeal.evidence_access_boundary: The reviewer may inspect sealed logs, policy diffs, training/evaluation summaries, retention records, and provider responses under confidentiality controls; the public release may publish only a sanctioned shell, hashes, non-sensitive summaries, and open-gate or failed-gate conclusions.
capture_controls: random or rotating assignment from a precommitted independent reviewer pool with signed conflict attestations
budget ledger showing provider cannot condition payment on scope, timing, finding, or publication posture
appeal log and public-shell duty for sustained objections, recusals, and reviewer replacements
separate evidence-access role from status-recognition or live-floor authority
